faq_heading: Langley golf course homes: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Langley golf course home cost?
faq.a: The 189 golf course houses that sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026 had a median of $1,400,000, with the middle half between $1,220,000 and $1,666,666. All Langley detached houses had a median of $1,378,000.

faq.q: What counts as a golf course home in Langley?
faq.a: It is a detached Langley house with a golf course entry under Site Influences. The seller’s agent decides whether to tick it, which is why the 189 sales counted here are a minimum.

faq.q: How fast do Langley golf course homes sell?
faq.a: 25 days at a median, closing at 97.0% of list, with 3% over the list price. All Langley houses took 22 days.

faq.q: Which Langley neighbourhoods have the most golf course homes?
faq.a: Walnut Grove had 60 sales with the flag, Langley City 30 and Fort Langley 22 between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026.

Every house in this Langley search is a detached home that the listing agent has tagged as beside or close to a golf course. The most golf course sales were in Walnut Grove (60), Langley City (30) and Fort Langley (22).

Of 777 detached houses that sold in Langley between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 189 (24%) carried a golf course flag. They sold for a median of $1,400,000, 2% above the $1,378,000 median for every Langley house.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a Langley golf course home

items.t: Measure the distance to the course and note which wall faces it. 189 Langley houses mention a golf course, and the listings do not say how near each one sits. Walnut Grove had the most flagged sales (60).

Walk the course side of the lot for marks on windows and siding, and ask whether the seller ever had damage or an insurance claim. The typical house was built in 1992, which tells you how old the roof and windows facing the course may be.
Read the title for any covenant, right-of-way or setback that links the lot to the course. The typical lot was 7,087 square feet, so the course side is often a large share of the yard.
Go back at a different hour, because mowers and play change what the yard sounds like. The median time to sell was 25 days here, so you rarely need to rush.
Price it against similar unflagged houses: $1,400,000 for golf course homes and $1,378,000 for all Langley houses, before you decide the course adds anything.
